convert_observation_to_model_query_conte: convert robot observations with strings, proprioception, and images into Gemini model query contents
encode_string_observations: encode task instructions and string observations from numpy arrays, bytes, or plain strings into JSON
encode_proprioceptive_observations: encode 1D proprioceptive observation arrays into JSON lists with automatic batch dimension removal
encode_image_observations: encode image observations from numpy, JAX, or TensorFlow arrays into model query contents with batch dimension handling
encode_conditioning_observations: encode conditioning observation tensors into the model query contents JSON payload
